topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: Found my wife's bucket list tucked away in a drawer, all tidy and planned out. List's got everything from skydiving to adopting a certain number of stray cats. Didn't see that one coming. I was thinking it'd be more along the lines of 'get a new set of dishes' or 'rearrange the living room.' But no, she's got her eyes set on scaling mountains and swimming with sharks. At night, the city's a place where secrets whisper, but in my home, the silence is just a different kind of quiet. I read through it, line by line, each one a step away from me. Guess I'm just another case where the details got a bit fuzzy.
